title: US Army soldier suspected of spying for Russia arrested in UK
description: The 41-year-old senior soldier is accused of national security offences and is being questioned in London.

title: David Walliams accused of sexual misconduct after losing injunction bid
description: ITN and the Guardian allege the comedian preyed on teenage girls and young women. He has denied all allegations.

title: Why Walliams' unprecedented legal battle to stay anonymous failed
description: The 55-year-old was named in reports by ITV News and the Guardian on Tuesday after losing a court bid to stop allegations being made public.

title: Meghan's father Thomas Markle back in federal custody after allegedly removing ankle monitor
description: The 82-year-old was placed under house detention in Florida last week after being charged over possession of child sex abuse material.

title: New photos are 'essential evidence' of possible SAS war crimes, inquiry told
description: The inquiry's lead barrister says photos of people lying on their backs with shots to the head may be evidence of possible war crimes.

title: Three Iran-backed suspects plotted attacks including RAF Fairford incident, US says
description: The US Department of Justice says the men were involved in a string of plots, including a major incident near the UK airbase that is used by US armed forces.

title: Prince George's artwork featured in Country Life magazine
description: The Prince of Wales features his 13-year-old son's drawing of a bird as part of a special edition of the magazine.

title: Antidepressant escitalopram more effective at preventing relapse, analysis finds
description: Three pills came top and outperformed Prozac for preventing relapse in a large number of patients.

title: US House blocks bid to impeach Defence Secretary Pete Hegseth, for now
description: Trump welcomes the outcome, praising Hegseth as a "Great American Patriot", but Democrats can try again next year.
